seededFrom.label: Swiss Typographic Museum Placard & Exhibition Wall Guide

display.purpose: Oversized tabular lesson numerals (00–04) in the left museum placard; scales down to 40px below 1080px.

headline.purpose: Single primary H1 slide title in the right reading column, balanced at max 24ch for classroom projection.

title.purpose: Placard unit titles (24px), overview header (22px), concept card headings (19px), and step titles (17px).

body.purpose: Standard instructional text across placard descriptions, cards, notes, and tables (pairs with .lead at 1.05–1.22rem).

label.purpose: Unit tags, capsule concept pills, prompt/note labels, timeline stamps, and overview slide metadata.

code.purpose: Copyable Cursor AI prompts inside dark prompt bars and inline HTML/shortcut tokens.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover inversion on footer navigation buttons and overview drawer cards.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: State transitions on top rail lesson tabs, brand button, copy CTA, and cover arc entries.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default CSS easing across color and background-color transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses transition and animation durations under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

components.name: Lesson Rail Tab

components.css: .ds-lesson-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); background: var(--bg-placard, #f4f4f1); border: 2px solid var(--line, #141414); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif); } .ds-lesson-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 18px; border: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--line-soft, #d4d4ce); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-subtle, #525252); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-lesson-tab:last-child { border-right: none; } .ds-lesson-tab.done { color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-lesson-tab:hover:not(.active) { background: #e9e9e3; color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-lesson-tab.active { background: var(--red, #d92b2b); color: #ffffff; } .ds-lesson-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--red, #d92b2b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-num { font-family: var(--font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", monospace); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: 0.9; }

components.css: .ds-placard { width: 320px; background: var(--bg-placard, #f4f4f1); border: 2px solid var(--line, #141414); padding: 28px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; font-family: var(--font-sans, "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-unit-tag { display: inline-block; background: var(--red, #d92b2b); color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 5px 11px; margin-bottom: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-big-num { font-family: var(--font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", monospace); font-size: 84px; line-height: 0.88; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.05em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-placard-title { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.32; } .ds-timeline { border-top: 2px solid var(--line, #141414); padding-top: 14px; display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-timeline-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr; gap: 10px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-timeline-row.current { font-weight: 700; color: var(--red-dark, #b91c1c); } .ds-timeline-time { font-family: var(--font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", monospace); font-size: 12.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink-subtle, #525252); } .ds-timeline-row.current .ds-timeline-time { color: var(--red-dark, #b91c1c); }

narrative.overview:
This design system treats a 4-lesson introductory coding curriculum like a Swiss architectural museum placard and exhibition wall guide. Instead of dark-mode developer templates or dense syntax slides, it pairs a calm Warm Stone Paper structural frame with crisp Gallery White reading plates so instructors can project clearly to the back row of a classroom while students copy Cursor prompts from narrower screens.

Every slide sits inside a disciplined 2px Carbon Ink grid: a persistent 4-lesson track rail at the top, a numbered exhibition placard on the left tracking time-boxed lesson pacing, a focused single-concept reading column on the right, and a keyboard-first control bar at the bottom. High-contrast color is rationed for active orientation, semantic conceptual coding (HTML, CSS, JS), and primary actions.
keyCharacteristics: Projection-scale legibility: Heavyweight Noto Sans TC headings (900) and oversized JetBrains Mono lesson numerals (00–04) engineered for classroom readability at distance.

Architectural linework over shadows: Zero drop shadows; spatial separation relies exclusively on 2px Carbon Ink (#141414) structural borders and tonal contrast between Warm Stone Paper (#f4f4f1) and Gallery White (#ffffff).

Rationed semantic color: Signal Red (#d92b2b) marks active navigation, primary actions, and JS/alert concepts, while Cobalt Blue (#1d4ed8) and Forest Green (#15803d) anchor CSS concepts and verified prompt outcomes.

Dual-audience utility: Fixed 100dvh stage on wide classroom displays (> 1080px) that reflows gracefully into a stacked, single-column reading scroll with a sticky footer on student laptops and mobile viewports (<= 1080px and <= 560px).

rules.name: The Rationed Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Red (#d92b2b) is reserved for the active lesson indicator, active step indices, primary copy/play buttons, and focus rings; never flood reading plates with red backgrounds outside the active overview card.

rules.name: The Pure Plate Rule
rules.body: Keep the right reading column on Gallery White (#ffffff) and confine structural chrome (rail, placard, footer) to Warm Stone Paper (#f4f4f1) so slide content always reads with maximum projector contrast.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every lesson index, timeline stamp, step counter, score readout, and SLIDE XX / 17 indicator must set JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so numbers align vertically and never jitter when updating.

rules.name: The Balanced Headline Rule
rules.body: Slide <h1> headlines wrap with text-wrap: balance and cap at 24ch (with .lead capped at 68ch) to prevent awkward single-character orphans in Traditional Chinese projection.

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add drop shadows, ambient blurs, or floating glass panels; if a container needs separation, give it a 2px solid #141414 border or shift its surface between #ffffff and #f4f4f1.

rules.name: The Sharp-Frame, Pill-Tag Rule
rules.body: Keep all structural containers, buttons, and code bars strictly 0px corner radius; reserve 999px capsule geometry exclusively for .pill metadata tags.

dos: Do frame primary structural zones, cards, and prompt bars with sharp 0px corners and 2px solid #141414 borders.
Do pair Noto Sans TC (900 weight) headlines with JetBrains Mono (tabular-nums) for all lesson numerals, timers, counters, and Cursor prompts.
Do restrict Signal Red (#d92b2b) to active orientation markers, primary action buttons, and focus outlines so back-row contrast remains unmistakable.
Do support full keyboard slide navigation (ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Space, 1–4, G, F, Escape) and preserve 3px solid #d92b2b :focus-visible outlines.
Do collapse the 100dvh desktop stage cleanly into a single-column vertical flow with a sticky bottom footer at <= 1080px.
donts: Don't add box-shadow, blur filters, or glassmorphism to cards, buttons, or modal sheets; follow The Zero-Shadow Rule.
Don't place decorative eyebrow kickers above the primary slide <h1> in the reading column; lesson context belongs exclusively in the top rail and left placard.
Don't apply rounded corners (border-radius > 0) to cards, buttons, or tables; capsule rounding (999px) belongs strictly to .pill taxonomy tags.
Don't introduce dark backgrounds onto the main .reading-column reading plates; reserve #141414 surfaces for .brand, .prompt-box, active .layer-toggle, and the playable game canvas.
Don't replace inline square-cap SVGs with emoji glyphs or external icon-font packages.
